rationale.ai-review: Fine-tuned LLM critics independently detect bugs in model-written code.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Natural-language critiques support human understanding and judgment of generated code.
rationale.automation-bias: Assisted contractors retained hallucinated bug claims humans alone avoided.
rationale.risk-routing: Critic scores prioritize which completions receive human re-review.
rationale.problem-statement-anchor: Critics outperformed experienced contractors at catching inserted AI-code bugs.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented and evaluated CriticGPT and FSBS.
rationale.agentic: Human-prompted complete code answers are reviewed at artifact granularity.
rationale.risk-quality: Critics detect correctness defects and improve review comprehensiveness.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Human-machine teams sometimes preserved critics' hallucinated findings.
rationale.method-experiment: Contractors performed controlled bug-insertion, critique, and comparison tasks.
